title: From Melbourne to Mexico: How SAP Concur and AI Help the San Francisco 49ers Take Their Game Global
summary: See how the San Francisco 49ers manage 38,000 miles of international travel with SAP Concur, from a historic Melbourne debut to Mexico City.
body_markdown:
As the San Francisco 49ers travel across continents during the 2026 NFL International Series, SAP Concur helps manage the travel, expenses, and payments that keep the team moving seamlessly.


Connect travel booking and expense management for total visibility and control


[Learn how](https://www.sap.com/products/financial-management/travel-and-expense-management.html)


In professional football, success is measured in seconds. A perfectly timed pass, a decisive block, or a touchdown can make all the difference. But behind every moment on the field is an enormous amount of planning, coordination, and execution that makes it possible. For organizations competing at the highest level, it is also built in the back office—in the systems and processes that keep a complex operation running, wherever in the world it happens to be.


For the San Francisco 49ers, the 2026 NFL season brings a new level of international complexity. With the NFL staging a record-breaking nine international games across seven countries and four continents, the league is taking American football to new audiences around the world. The 49ers are part of that global journey, with international matchups in Melbourne, Australia, and Mexico City, Mexico.


The 49ers lead the way in the NFL in terms of miles traveled in the 2026- 2027 season, with an estimated 38,000 miles, meaning coordinating flights, hotels, travel arrangements, expenses, and vendor payments is a logistical feat.

## **More than a travel challenge**


Moving a professional sports franchise across continents is a different proposition from an away trip to another city. When the 49ers travel internationally, they bring players, coaches, medical staff, equipment, and a full organizational support operation with them. Expenses are incurred in multiple currencies. Vendors must be contracted and paid across different legal and regulatory environments. And finance teams back home need visibility into spending as happens—not weeks later, after expense reports have made their way through a manual process.


## **The team behind the team**


As an SAP Concur customer, alongside other SAP solutions such as SAP Business AI Platform, the 49ers use the platform to manage travel booking and expense reimbursement in one integrated environment. Today, 95% of the organization’s business travel bookings flow through SAP Concur, giving the finance team centralized visibility across the travel program.


The San Francisco 49ers also uses AI capabilities within SAP Concur, including expense automation and intelligent recommendations, helping simplify expense management and streamline processes for employees and the accounting team.


“We use \[SAP\] Concur as our invoice, expense reimbursement, and travel booking platform,” said Jeremiah Lagasca, Accounting Manager at the San Francisco 49ers. “The accounting team has gained significant operational efficiencies by having all these components managed under one roof. Furthermore, this allows our users to have a more streamlined process for business travel and vendor payments.”


The impact is measurable. By streamlining its financial processes through SAP Concur, the 49ers have reduced processing times for invoices and expense reports by 32%, helping the accounting team work more efficiently and manage the demands of the organization.


## **Connected systems, connected teams**


Just as success on the field depends on every part of the team working together, operational success depends on processes and data being connected rather than siloed.


SAP Concur brings travel, expense, and invoice management into a single platform reducing the manual handoffs and reconciliation work that tend to accumulate when these functions live in separate systems. For finance teams, that means better visibility into spending and faster close cycles. For employees traveling on behalf of the organization—whether the destination is Santa Clara or Mexico City—it means a more consistent and straightforward experience, from booking a trip to submitting a claim.


As the team prepares to kick off in Mexico City on Sunday, the logistical work required to get them there is already done. The bookings are made, the expenses are tracked, the vendors are paid. That is not incidental to the team’s performance: it is part of what makes it possible.


With SAP Concur helping bring travel, expenses, and payments together, the 49ers can focus on what matters most: performance, and competing at the highest level, wherever the game takes them.
